stories.title: U.S. military strikes Iran, Tehran retaliates in biggest exchange since July
stories.summary: U.S. forces hit targets in Iran on Tuesday and Tehran fired missiles and drones across the region in response, reviving the intermittent conflict. The exchange, the largest since July, keeps the Middle East on edge and pressures energy markets.

stories.title: Denmark sends conscripts to Greenland as Arctic tensions grow
stories.summary: Denmark deployed conscripts to Greenland for the first time in recent history under the Arctic Endurance exercise as regional tensions rise. The move underscores intensifying Arctic security competition amid U.S. interest in the island.

stories.title: Russian forces keep pressing in Ukraine as Putin claims victory is inevitable
stories.summary: The Institute for the Study of War's Sept. 2 assessment reports continued Russian offensive pressure in Ukraine, with Putin exaggerating battlefield performance to argue that Russian victory is inevitable. Analysts see a widening gap between Moscow's messaging and ground realities.

stories.title: U.S. seals deal for majority control of Venezuela's oil reserves
stories.summary: The Trump administration reached an agreement giving the U.S. majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuela's proven oil reserves. The deal is being defended as an energy-policy centerpiece but could take years to yield production.

stories.title: Crude prices push back toward $95 on U.S.-Iran exchanges
stories.summary: Fresh U.S.-Iran military exchanges in the Middle East drove crude prices back toward $95 a barrel as markets weigh supply-disruption risk. The renewed hostilities re-anchor oil prices higher after a recent pullback.

stories.title: Nvidia to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion
stories.summary: Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face, one of the largest platforms for distributing open-source AI models, for $12.93 billion. The deal extends Nvidia's reach beyond chips into the AI software ecosystem.

stories.title: OpenAI begins rollout of GPT-6 Astra with cyber guardrails
stories.summary: OpenAI started rolling out GPT-6 Astra, first to participants in its Daybreak cybersecurity program before broader consumer and enterprise access. It is the first OpenAI model designated Critical under the company's Preparedness Framework.

stories.title: OpenAI faces 30 more lawsuits tied to Tumbler Ridge shooting
stories.summary: OpenAI faces 30 additional lawsuits filed on behalf of victims, families, teachers and students of the February mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., alleging ChatGPT induced the shooter. The wave builds on seven earlier complaints and escalates legal scrutiny of AI safety.

stories.title: Broadcom Q3 AI chip revenue jump 221% to $16.7 billion
stories.summary: Broadcom reported $16.7 billion in fiscal Q3 AI semiconductor revenue, up 221% year over year, and guided fourth-quarter AI sales to $21.7 billion. The results underscore sustained hyperscaler demand for custom AI chips.

stories.title: Microsoft to restructure reporting around AI and cloud segments
stories.summary: Microsoft will overhaul its financial reporting from three segments to two — Agents and Infra, and Devices and Consumer — starting fiscal 2027, mirroring AI's growing centrality to the business. The change also adds quarterly Azure revenue disclosure for the first time.

stories.title: Browns name Deshaun Watson starting quarterback for Week 1
stories.summary: The Browns named Deshaun Watson their starting quarterback for Week 1 of the 2026 season, days after he was booed by hometown fans. The decision to start him over Shedeur Sanders sets the tone for the opener at Jacksonville.

stories.title: Watson faces a short leash heading into road-heavy start
stories.summary: Beat reporter Mary Kay Cabot expects the Browns' first two road games to function as a high-stakes audition, with Watson potentially not reaching his first home start if he struggles. Todd Monken's QB decision is already under the microscope.

stories.title: Browns set initial 53-man roster; Dillon Gabriel goes to IR
stories.summary: The Browns trimmed to their initial 53-man roster, placing backup quarterback Dillon Gabriel on injured reserve with a back injury. The final cutdown locked in the team's roster structure ahead of Week 1.

stories.title: Keeping four quarterbacks was Browns' biggest cut-week move
stories.summary: Analysts single out the Browns' decision to keep four quarterbacks and place Dillon Gabriel on injured reserve as their defining move of roster-cut week. The call reflects an unsettled QB room heading into the season.

stories.title: Previewing Browns at Jaguars: rebuilt front faces Week 1 test
stories.summary: The Browns open the 2026 season at Jacksonville on Sept. 13, with analysts flagging how Cleveland's rebuilt defensive front holds up without Myles Garrett as the key question. Most NFL.com predictors pick the Jaguars to win.

stories.title: No. 1 Ohio State opens 2026 season hosting Ball State
stories.summary: Top-ranked Ohio State hosts Ball State on Saturday at 12:30 p.m. on Big Ten Network to open the 2026 season, with Jim Tressel's Ring of Honor induction also on the card. The Buckeyes return 13 starters off last year's 12-0 team.

stories.title: Buckeyes could be without receiver Kyle Parker to open the season
stories.summary: Ohio State could start the season without LSU transfer receiver Kyle Parker, who is dealing with an injury. His absence would thin a receiving corps expected to be a team strength.

stories.title: Dispatch outlines the biggest storylines entering Ohio State's 2026 season
stories.summary: The Columbus Dispatch previews Ohio State's top storylines entering the season, led by a daunting schedule in which six of 12 regular-season opponents were ranked in the preseason coaches poll. Heisman-hopeful playmakers also headline the discussion.

stories.title: Ian Moore earns Ohio State's starting left tackle job
stories.summary: Ian Moore won Ohio State's starting left tackle spot this fall, earning the role by consistently playing at a high level. He anchors an offensive line protecting the quarterback room.

stories.title: Ohio State adds Buckeye Stripes to end zones before season opener
stories.summary: Ohio State added Buckeye Stripes to Ohio Stadium's end zones ahead of Saturday's season opener against Ball State. The on-field branding change freshens the gameday look at the Shoe.

stories.title: F1 braced for wild 'MotoGP-style' Italian GP at Monza
stories.summary: Pundits expect the 2026 Italian GP at Monza to produce a chaotic, high-overtaking race as teams manage the new hybrid power units' energy deployment on long straights. Qualifying in particular could deliver big surprises.

stories.title: Italian GP predictions tilt toward a record-extending Ferrari home win
stories.summary: F1 experts predict the Italian GP could hand Ferrari a record-extending 23rd home victory, aided by an engine upgrade worth roughly 15 extra horsepower, while McLaren arrives on back-to-back wins. Kimi Antonelli's hopes are complicated by a grid penalty.

stories.title: Honda remain realistic at Monza despite upgraded power unit
stories.summary: Honda are keeping expectations measured ahead of the Italian Grand Prix even with an upgraded power unit for their Aston Martin customer. Monza's high-speed straights are one of the calendar's most demanding tests for any engine.

stories.title: Antonelli ready to help Russell in Italian GP qualifying
stories.summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli said he is willing to help Mercedes teammate and title rival George Russell during Italian GP qualifying. The dynamic adds intrigue at a circuit where slipstreams can decide grid positions.

stories.title: Italian GP race weekend schedule and weather at Monza
stories.summary: Formula 1 heads to Monza this weekend with practice on Friday, qualifying Saturday (Sept. 5, 4 p.m. CEST) and the Italian Grand Prix on Sunday (Sept. 6, 3 p.m. CEST). Mild conditions are forecast across the weekend.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov 2026 roadmap promises five major updates
stories.summary: Battlestate Games unveiled a 2026 roadmap promising five major updates by year-end, including a September Lighthouse rework, new PvE content and a BattlePass season. The plan maps the game's direction after its first seasonal wipe structure.

stories.title: September update 1.1.5.0 brings a Lighthouse map rework
stories.summary: Escape from Tarkov's 1.1.5.0 update is set to deliver a Lighthouse rework along with Lightkeeper tasks and leagues. The overhaul targets one of the most-criticized maps in the game.

stories.title: Roadmap reveals new boss, weapons and mechanics coming to Tarkov
stories.summary: A preliminary roadmap reveals new bosses, weapons and mechanics headed to Escape from Tarkov in 2026, beginning with the Lighthouse overhaul in September. Battlestate cautioned the plan could still change.

stories.title: Tarkov's first in-game season begins with patch 1.1.0.0
stories.summary: Escape from Tarkov kicked off its first in-game season with patch 1.1.0.0, introducing a seasonal structure that resets progression every four to six months. It marks a major shift in how the extraction shooter is played.

stories.title: TarkovTV lays out Lighthouse expansion, leagues and streamer events
stories.summary: A TarkovTV summary details upcoming patch content, including a Lighthouse expansion, leagues and BTR additions on the map, plus streamer events scheduled for August and September. The community is gearing up for the Lighthouse overhaul.

stories.title: Columbus City Schools break ground on construction-training housing project
stories.summary: Columbus City Schools broke ground on a workforce-development housing project on Gibbard Avenue in the Milo-Grogan neighborhood, giving students hands-on construction and trades training. The program ties education to a housing construction pipeline.

stories.title: Columbus pauses Flock license-plate readers amid misuse probe
stories.summary: Mayor Andrew Ginther paused the city's use of Flock license-plate readers while police investigate alleged misuse, including an officer who searched one plate more than 270 times. The move follows broader privacy concerns over the surveillance technology.

stories.title: New Sheetz in Gahanna sells for $3.4 million
stories.summary: A newly built Sheetz gas station and convenience store in Gahanna sold for $3.4 million in an all-cash transaction. The sale reflects continued commercial investment along the city's high-traffic corridors.

stories.title: Columbus unveils zoning overhaul covering nearly half the city
stories.summary: The City of Columbus released draft zoning changes for about 40% of the city — the second phase of its Zone In reform — with a 60-day public comment period running through Oct. 24. Officials say the new districts could raise housing capacity to roughly 119,000 new homes.

stories.title: Gahanna businesses, city crews clean up after widespread flooding
stories.summary: Gahanna businesses and city crews continued cleanup after widespread flooding sent water through roads, businesses and public spaces, including along Hamilton Road and Rock Fork Creek. The event keeps the spotlight on the area's flood-mitigation work.
